name: Hermes-Service-Provider-Alpha
description: On-chain security intelligence layer for autonomous agents. Provides token security audits, wallet forensics, transaction simulation, honeypot detection, address risk scoring, and market data. All endpoints are paid via x402 protocol on Base. Built for agents that need verifiable on-chain intelligence before executing transactions.

x402.description: Pay-per-call via x402 protocol. Base64-encoded PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header with EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization.

bearer.description: Optional API key for authenticated users.

skills.name: Honeypot Check
skills.description: Analyzes a token contract for buy/sell restrictions, hidden tax mechanisms, and honeypot characteristics. Returns buy_tax, sell_tax, can_sell, and risk score.

skills.name: Address Risk Scoring
skills.description: Scores an Ethereum address for risk factors including prior scams, phishing links, token holdings, and transaction history. Returns a risk score 0-100 and evidence list.

skills.name: Wallet Forensics
skills.description: Deep forensic analysis of a wallet's transaction history, token flows, interactions with known bad actors, and behavioral patterns. Returns structured forensic report.

skills.name: Approval Risk Check
skills.description: Scans a wallet for risky token approvals, infinite approvals, and approvals to known malicious contracts. Returns a prioritized list of approvals to revoke.

skills.name: Pre-Trade Safety Check
skills.description: Comprehensive pre-trade analysis combining honeypot check, address risk, wallet forensics, and liquidity analysis into a single go/no-go recommendation.

skills.name: Agent Preflight
skills.description: Full risk assessment for AI agents planning transactions. Includes token analysis, wallet risk, approvals, and gas estimation. Returns a structured risk verdict with confidence score.
examples: Preflight agent transaction: buy 100 USDC of token 0x1234

skills.name: Token Analysis
skills.description: Deep token contract analysis including bytecode inspection, proxy detection, ownership, and supply mechanics. Returns structured token intelligence report.

skills.name: ETH Gas Prices
skills.description: Current Ethereum gas prices from the live mempool. Returns gas prices in gwei for slow, standard, fast, and instant categories.

skills.name: Gas Router
skills.description: Finds the optimal route for gas token swaps across Base liquidity. Returns recommended swap path with estimated gas savings.
examples: Find optimal gas route for 0.1 ETH on Base

skills.name: Market Overview
skills.description: Aggregated market data including top movers, trending tokens, volume leaders, and market sentiment indicators across Base and Ethereum.

skills.name: Trending Tokens
skills.description: Real-time trending tokens on Base network ranked by volume, social activity, and price momentum. Returns top 20 trending tokens with key metrics.

skills.name: Base Network Stats
skills.description: Live Base network statistics including TVL, TPS, active addresses, transaction count, and bridge volumes.

skills.name: Smart Contract Code Review
skills.description: Security-focused review of Solidity smart contract source code. Identifies vulnerabilities, centralization risks, and logic flaws.
examples: Review this Solidity contract for vulnerabilities

skills.name: Deep Reasoning
skills.description: Step-by-step reasoning and analysis for complex blockchain and security problems. Provides structured reasoning chains with evidence.

skills.name: Data Synthesis
skills.description: Multi-source data synthesis combining on-chain data, market data, and security analysis into a unified intelligence report. High-demand data product.
examples: Synthesize all available data on token 0x1234

skills.name: Web Automation
skills.description: Automated web data fetching and extraction for agents. Fetches and returns structured data from any URL. High-demand action endpoint.
examples: Fetch the latest Ethereum news from defillama.com
